# Required status checks for `main`.
#
# This file mirrors the required-status-check contexts configured on `main`'s
# branch protection. It is the version-controlled contract that
# scripts/check-required-status-checks.sh enforces: every context listed here
# must be emittable by some job in .github/workflows/*.yml, so a job rename or
# removal that would leave a required check unable to report fails the pull
# request that causes it instead of silently stalling the merge queue.
#
# When a required check is added, renamed, or removed:
#   1. update the workflow that emits it,
#   2. update this file in the same pull request (the gate enforces the match),
#   3. update `main`'s branch-protection required-status-checks to match.
# `scripts/check-required-status-checks.sh --verify-branch-protection` (run with
# GitHub admin credentials) checks this file against live branch protection.
#
# One context name per line, sorted. Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are
# ignored.
